Clipping Volumes | Novorender
Jul 4, 2025The positive side of this plane, i.e. signed_distance > 0, is considered outside the halfspace, whereas the negative side is inside. Points that lie outside will be clipped, while points inside will be rendered. Single plane To illustrate this, let's create a simple clipping volume with a single plane along the yz axes, effectively clipping everything to the right of center.
